applies_to: plural, leaf-form and plural-spelling synonyms of existing herb_spice rows
policy: Same ingredient + same plant part + same form as an existing row -> synonym (variant-policy-1 extended to plural and leaf forms). A different plant part never maps (fenugreek leaves vs fenugreek seed, basil seeds vs basil, chilli seeds vs chilli). Processed forms (extract, oil) are never mapped. Bare ambiguous base rows (coriander, dill) are not widened. A leaf form is allowed only for the listed herbs, whose culinary part is the leaf; where no source names the part the row says so.
